description.en: Plugins published by TwinsEarth, including the AI Prison governance bundle.
description.zh: TwinsEarth 发布的插件，包含 AI Prison 治理插件。

description.en: Wraps the aiprison CLI as six DSH tools (levels, status, demo, drill, inspect, verify, repair-tail) and adds a sidebar panel showing the L0–L5 grading matrix together with the durable ledger's audit-chain integrity and record count. Open it from the sidebar's shield entry; the panel is read-only and never writes to the ledger. Ledgers live in <session working directory>/.ai-prison unless a data directory is configured. Every capability-removal backend (GRAM, TLM, hardware binding, MicroVM isolation) stays simulated, so the tools audit and demonstrate governance instead of enforcing real isolation.
description.zh: 把 aiprison CLI 封装为六个 DSH 工具（levels、status、demo、drill、inspect、verify、repair-tail），并在侧边栏增加一个面板：展示 L0–L5 分级矩阵，以及落盘账本的审计链完整性与记录数。从侧边栏的盾牌入口打开；面板只读，不会写入数据目录。账本默认写到 <会话工作目录>/.ai-prison，也可在配置里指定数据目录。GRAM、TLM、硬件绑定、MicroVM 隔离等能力摘除后端全部为内存模拟 —— 这些工具用于审计与演示治理流程，并不执行真实隔离。
